shared_elements: head with elaborate coiffure rendered as a mass of small regular curls
long ornate beard as patterned rows
headdress/crown-like element above the brow with a decorative band
large almond eye shown frontally within a profile head
repeated small ornamental units used as surface infill
justification: Both depict a dignified figure strictly in profile whose hair and beard are treated as decorative masses of tightly regularised curls beneath a banded headdress, with the eye rendered frontally in the profile face \u2014 a fairly specific and conventional way of building a head. The biggest difference in content is that A shows a whole standing winged, bird-headed being holding objects beside a stylised plant with an inscription band above, whereas B shows only a wholly human bearded head with a tall fluted crown and no accompanying motifs.
